name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.83.0 — a design review hub, one per machine (`design-hub.js`, `spec-paths design-hub`; state under `~/.claude/design-hub/`, port 4600 by default, `base` configured once with `config --base`), mounts every registered project under `/p/<name>/` through the same request handler `design-atlas.js serve` uses, its front page an inbox of open look stops newest first across projects; every mock look stop — the mocks driver's five looks (`shapes`, `journey:<j>`, `theme`, `review:<j>`, `signoff`), `/spec:sketch` ratification, `/spec:atlas` — now opens a stop on the hub with `stop open` and prints exactly the verified link plus the fixed reply line, then ends the turn; the driver's marks (`shape-picked`, `journey-approved`, `theme-picked`, `journey-reviewed`, `approved`) refuse without a decided stop for their key (from the page or `stop decide --by chat`) and derive the ledger's `rejected` cell from the picked group; the look-stop rule now names two shapes — catalog stops (Storybook) unchanged, mock stops the hub link. 7.82.1 — spec-queue add refuses unknown --flags (exit 2, nothing written) instead of folding them into the payload; a spec path plus a stray --root once landed as a free-text prompt item. 7.82.0 — look stops are now decided on the served atlas page instead of a terminal question: `lib/mocks-picks.js` is the sole reader/writer of `design/mocks/picks.json` (candidate groups, one group per flow); `design-atlas.js` exports `buildAtlas`, `page`, `frameTag`, `createRequestHandler` and runs its CLI dispatch only under `require.main`, with new `GET /__picks/list` and `POST /__picks/decide` routes; an open or decided stop renders in place, in the section its screens already live in, as a compare table (one row per step, one column per candidate) with a one-click Pick this / Approve / Change, re-pickable until the mocks driver consumes it; the server stamps a `notes-scope` meta tag on every page it serves so the notes layer shows exactly one scope per page and hides its bar while the lightbox is open.
